news.title: X now offers an MCP server to make its platform easier for AI tools to use
news.description: X has launched a hosted MCP server, making it easier for developers to connect AI applications with the company’s API.

news.title: Amazon launches new $1 billion FDE org, following OpenAI and Anthropic
news.description: Engineers on the new team will embed within companies to deploy purpose-built agents, focusing on fast deployments and customer self-sufficiency.

news.title: Lumo, Proton’s privacy-focused AI chatbot, gets an upgrade
news.description: Proton's Lumo 2.0 is dropping this week, giving users a broader variety of capabilities.

news.title: Crypto exchange OKX wants AI agents to hire and pay each other
news.description: OKX is bringing together payments, identity, and reputation into a marketplace for AI agents.

news.title: Ford rehires human engineers after AI fails to match quality checks
news.description: The car-maker found AI quality checks failed to match the skill of veteran technicians.

news.title: Tech firms are blaming AI for mega device and console price rises
news.description: Xbox consoles, Nintendo's new Switch 2 and Valve's Steam Deck are just some of the gadgets seeing price hikes in recent months.

news.title: OpenAI Has New AI Models. Here’s Why You Can’t Use Them
news.description: The White House asked OpenAI to delay the rollout of its GPT-5.6 AI models, two weeks after Anthropic had to take its most advanced AI models offline.

news.title: Notion killing Skiff-influenced email app since most users use AI agents instead
news.description: Notion is "going all in on using agents to run your inbox."
